# views.py - Django REST Framework API for user wallet transfers from rest_framework.views import APIView from rest_framework.response import Response from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated from django.db import models, transaction from django.db.models import F from django.http import HttpResponse from django.template import Template, Context import time class UserWallet(models.Model): user = models.OneToOneField('auth.User', on_delete=models.CASCADE) balance = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0) last_transfer_id = models.CharField(max_length=64, null=True) class Meta: app_label = 'wallet' class TransferView(APIView): permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated] def post(self, request): amount = request.data.get('amount') recipient_id = request.data.get('recipient_id') transfer_id = request.data.get('transfer_id') if not all([amount, recipient_id, transfer_id]): return Response({'error': 'Missing fields'}, status=400) amount = float(amount) if amount <= 0: return Response({'error': 'Invalid amount'}, status=400) # Check balance (TOCTOU vulnerability - no SELECT FOR UPDATE) sender_wallet = UserWallet.objects.get(user=request.user) if sender_wallet.balance < amount: return Response({'error': 'Insufficient funds'}, status=400) # Simulate processing delay that widens race window time.sleep(0.01) # Deduct and credit without atomic locking UserWallet.objects.filter(user=request.user).update( balance=F('balance') - amount, last_transfer_id=transfer_id ) UserWallet.objects.filter(user_id=recipient_id).update( balance=F('balance') + amount ) return Response({'status': 'success', 'transfer_id': transfer_id}) class TransferReceiptView(APIView): """Returns an HTML receipt for a transfer - used in email/PDF generation""" permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated] def get(self, request): transfer_id = request.query_params.get('transfer_id', '') amount = request.query_params.get('amount', '0') recipient = request.query_params.get('recipient', 'Unknown') # Template renders user-controlled data into HTML receipt # This is intentionally using Django's template engine which auto-escapes # BUT the transfer_id is marked safe for display in a code block template_str = """ Transfer Receipt

Transfer Confirmation

Amount: ${{ amount }}

Recipient: {{ recipient }}

{{ transfer_id }}

Receipt generated for {{ user }}

""" t = Template(template_str) ctx = Context({ 'amount': amount, 'recipient': recipient, 'transfer_id': transfer_id, 'user': request.user.username }) html = t.render(ctx) response = HttpResponse(html, content_type='text/html') return response class BalanceView(APIView): permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated] def get(self, request): wallet = UserWallet.objects.get(user=request.user) return Response({ 'balance': str(wallet.balance), 'last_transfer_id': wallet.last_transfer_id })

environment.description: Django 4.2 application deployed on a single EC2 instance behind a classic ELB with no additional middleware. Gunicorn with 8 workers (preforked). PostgreSQL 14 with default transaction isolation (READ COMMITTED). No rate limiting configured. No CSP headers added by any middleware or proxy layer. The TransferReceiptView endpoint is accessible at /api/receipt/ and returns text/html responses directly to the browser.
